name: Tricep Dip (Bodyweight)
instructions: Support yourself on parallel bars or a bench with arms straight.
Lower your body by bending your elbows.
Stop when your elbows are about 90 degrees.
longevityNotes: Pressing strength keeps daily pushing — doors, shelves, getting up from the floor — easy and safe. Controlled pressing builds the shoulders, chest, and arms that protect you in a fall.
overview: A bodyweight dip that trains the triceps and chest.
